blocks.text: Apartment Cleanout Services in Markham, Ontario — Full Units Emptied, Elevators and All

c: Clearing an apartment isn’t like clearing a house — everything has to travel down a hallway, into an elevator you had to reserve, past a concierge with rules, and out through a loading dock on a schedule. We do this every week across Markham. Our fully insured crew meets you at the unit, quotes the whole cleanout free and in person, coordinates with your building’s requirements, and empties the apartment — often between your elevator booking’s start and end time.

blocks.text: From Downtown Markham Towers to Thornhill Walk-Ups — We Know These Buildings

Markham's rental and condo stock is as varied as the city itself: glass high-rises around Markham Centre, established buildings in Thornhill and Milliken, stacked towns in Cornell and Berczy, and basement apartments across every neighbourhood. Live Junk Free has cleaned out units in all of them — earning Google reviews from owners, tenants, landlords and property managers who needed a unit empty by a deadline and got exactly that.

A studio's worth of furniture is a small load; a packed two-bedroom is a bigger one. That's the entire pricing logic. Being on the 24th floor, needing the freight elevator, or living at the far end of the hallway adds nothing to your bill.

Apartments hide their volume — closets, lockers, balconies, that storage cage in the parking garage. A phone guess would shortchange one of us. Instead, a crew member views the actual unit and everything going, then hands you one firm, free, no-obligation number.
{{fact:taxNote}}. {{fact:pricingIntro.extra}} If the elevator runs slow or the couch needs dismantling to leave the unit, the price doesn't budge.
{{fact:insuranceDocs}}. Tell us your building's rules and we'll arrive ready to follow them, keeping you onside with the board and the concierge.

The walkthrough and quote commit you to nothing. Green-light the number and the crew starts immediately; decline and we leave with a handshake, no fee. Once approved, the figure is frozen no matter how the job unfolds.
National junk brands price in their royalty fees; we have none to pass along.
What an Apartment Cleanout Costs in Markham
No hourly billing that punishes slow elevators, no high-rise surcharges, no invoice edits afterward. Book your free Markham walkthrough and get the real number first.
An Empty Unit by Your Deadline — Here's the Process
Whether the lease ends Friday or the condo closes at month-end, the path from full to empty is four steps:

items.title: 1. Book Around Your Building's Schedule
text: Call +1 647 922 5865 or book online, and tell us about your elevator window if you have one.

items.title: 2. Walk the Unit, Get the Number
text: Show us the apartment plus anything extra — the balcony, the storage locker, the parking-level cage. One free, quote follows at the onsite estimate. Yours to accept or decline.

items.title: 3. We Empty the Unit, Building-Politely
text: {{fact:propertyProtection}}. You supervise as much or as little as you like.

items.title: 4., Photographed-Ready, and Responsibly Sorted
text: {{fact:cleanupScope}}. The truckload then splits by destination: donation partners first, recyclers for metals and electronics, landfill only for the remainder.

Frequently Asked Questions About Apartment Cleanouts in Markham, ON

items.q: Q: How much does it cost to clean out an apartment in Markham?
a: A: Pricing follows truck volume, nothing else. Floor level, elevator waits and hallway length never affect it.

items.q: Q: My building requires an elevator booking — how does that work with you?
a: A: Perfectly, as long as we know the window. Tell us your reservation time when booking and we’ll arrive ready to load within it. Our crews are used to Markham condo logistics — protection pads for the elevator cab, respect for time limits, and quick staging at the loading dock.
{{fact:insuranceDocs}}. We’re fully insured and can provide documentation to your property management in advance — just mention it when you book so it’s sorted before cleanout day.

items.q: Q: A tenant left everything behind — can you clear the unit fast?
a: A: This is one of our most common Markham calls.

items.q: Q: Can you empty my parents' condo? They're downsizing and it's emotional.
a: A: We handle downsizing and estate condo cleanouts regularly, and we treat them differently than a standard job — slower pace, family involvement welcomed, and anything sentimental or valuable pulled aside rather than loaded. Usable furniture goes to donation, which many families find comforting.
